_comment: Combat Tweaks chat messages. Use full sentences that still fit one chat line (about 45 characters after the prefix); longer ones wrap. Color tokens: {default} {red} {lightblue} {yellow} {lime} {grey}. {team} is the team color of the named player. Keep every {placeholder} when translating.
rush_attempt: {rush_prefix} {team}{name}{default} tried to rush into a blocked zone.
barrier_locked: {rush_prefix} Rushing is closed until the barrier opens.
barrier_unlocked: {rush_prefix} The barrier is open, rushing is allowed.
no_access: {admin_prefix} You don't have access to this command.
must_be_alive: {admin_prefix} You need to be alive to place a corner.
zone_corner1: {admin_prefix} Corner set. Type !ct zone at the other corner.
zone_corner2: {admin_prefix} Box drawn. Type !ct zone save to keep it.
zone_saved: {admin_prefix} Zone {number} is saved for this map.
zone_nothing: {admin_prefix} Nothing to save yet. Start with !ct zone.
zone_list_empty: {admin_prefix} This map doesn't have any zones yet.
zone_removed: {admin_prefix} Zone {number} was removed from this map.
zone_not_found: {admin_prefix} This map doesn't have a zone {number}.
reloaded: {admin_prefix} Settings, zones and messages are reloaded.
status_in_console: {admin_prefix} The status report is in your console.
rush_center_wait:
[ANTI-RUSH]
Opens at the last player
